originalTitle: Hospitals deliberately targeted by Sudan's RSF fighters, BBC finds
title: Hospitals in Sudan Need Our Kindness!
content:
Hello, My Little Friends!

Hello, hello, my dear friends! I am your special news reporter, and I bring you stories from all over our beautiful continent of Africa. Today, I want to talk about something important happening in a country called Sudan. Sudan is a big country in Africa, with amazing rivers and deserts, and friendly people just like you and me. We love to share stories and learn new things together. Today's story is a little bit sad, but it's very important that we talk about it. It’s about helping people and being kind, which are things we all care about very much.

A Special Place Called Sudan

Imagine looking at a map of Africa. Sudan is a big country right there! It has a long river called the Nile flowing through it, which is super cool. Many people live in Sudan, and they have schools, homes, and special places to help them when they are not feeling well. Did you know? Sudan is home to many different kinds of animals too, like elephants and giraffes! It also has pyramids, just like Egypt, which are thousands of years old. The people of Sudan love to tell stories and sing songs, just like we do.

What Are Hospitals For?

Now, let's talk about hospitals. Do you know what a hospital is? It's like a big, kind house where special people, called doctors and nurses, work very hard. They help sick people get better. If you fall and hurt your knee, or if you have a tummy ache, a hospital is where you can go to feel safe and get medicine. Doctors and nurses are like superheroes! They wear special clothes and know how to fix broken bones, give you gentle medicine, and make you smile when you're feeling scared. They take care of tiny babies, brave grandpas, and everyone in between. Hospitals are places of hope and healing. Did you know? The very first hospitals were built many, many years ago to help people stay healthy. They have always been important places for communities. Doctors and nurses learn for many years to be good at their jobs!

Sad News from Sudan's Hospitals

Now for the sad part of our story. In Sudan, some grown-ups are having a big fight. It’s not a good fight, like playing games; it’s a very serious one. And something very, very wrong is happening because of this fighting. Many hospitals in Sudan are being hurt. Yes, on purpose! Some of the grown-ups who are fighting are attacking these hospitals. This means the places where doctors and nurses help sick people are being damaged, or even made to stop working completely. Imagine if your school couldn't open because it was hurt. Or if your playground was broken and you couldn't play. It's like that, but for places where people go to get better. This makes many, many people very sad and worried.

Who Gets Hurt When Hospitals Stop?

When hospitals get hurt, it's not just the buildings that suffer. It's the people inside! Think about a little baby who needs special care, or a grandma who is very sick and needs medicine. Where will they go? Who will help them? Doctors and nurses, who are so brave and kind, sometimes can't do their work because the hospitals are not safe. People who are already not feeling well get even sicker because they can't get the help they need. This is why it's so important for hospitals to always be safe places. Did you know? In some hospitals, there are special rooms just for tiny babies born too early. These babies need lots of special care to grow big and strong. If their hospital is hurt, it makes it very hard for them to get better.

Why This Is Not Allowed

Hurting hospitals is against very important rules. These rules are like the rules we have in our homes or schools – they help everyone stay safe and be kind. But these are very big rules, for all the world! There's a big group of people from all over the world, called the United Nations. They have a kind man named Mr. Volker Türk. He helps make sure everyone follows these important rules. He says that hurting hospitals on purpose is very, very wrong. He even said it might be something called 'war crimes'. This means breaking the most important rules of kindness and safety during a big fight. These rules say that hospitals, doctors, nurses, and all sick people must *always* be kept safe. It's a rule for humanity, for all of us. Did you know? The United Nations works in many countries, trying to help people live in peace. They have people called 'peacekeepers' who wear blue hats and try to keep everyone safe. They also help deliver food and water to people who need it.

People Who Help (The United Nations)

The United Nations is like a big family of countries that tries to solve problems together. They are very worried about the hospitals in Sudan. They want the fighting to stop, and they want the hospitals to be safe again so doctors and nurses can help everyone. They remind everyone that hospitals are special places that should never be touched by fighting. It’s a very clear rule: leave hospitals alone! They are for healing, not for hurting. They are working hard to make sure these important rules are followed.

What Can We Do?

Even though we are far away, we can still do something. We can think good thoughts and wish for peace in Sudan. We can be extra kind to our friends and family here, because every little bit of kindness makes the world a better place. We can also learn about Sudan and other countries. The more we learn, the more we understand, and the more we can help. Maybe one day, you will be a doctor or a peacekeeper, helping people in the world! Did you know? Being kind to someone can make them feel much better, just like medicine! A smile or a kind word can be very powerful.

Let's Hope for Peace!

So, my dear friends, let's remember the brave doctors and nurses in Sudan. Let's remember the sick people and the children who need help. Let's hope that the fighting stops soon, and that all the hospitals can be safe again, full of healing and hope. We wish for peace and kindness to shine brightly in Sudan, just like the African sun. Thank you for listening to this important news. Keep being kind, keep learning, and keep sharing your beautiful smiles!
summary: Hospitals in the country of Sudan are being hurt on purpose, making it very hard for sick people and children to get better, and kind people from around the world say this is very wrong and against important rules.
whyMatters: It's important because everyone, especially children and people who are sick, should always be safe and be able to get help from doctors and nurses when they need it, no matter what is happening around them.

originalTitle: Argentinian judge drops fraud investigation into Milei over crypto scandal
title: Good News from Far Away! President Milei and His Digital Money!
content:
Hello, Super Kids! Your News Buddy is Here!

Hey there, amazing young explorers and future leaders of Africa! It’s your favourite news friend, Jambo, bringing you exciting stories from all over the world! I hope you're ready for some fun learning today. We have a very special story from a country far, far away, called Argentina. It’s about a very important person called a President and some super cool "internet money"! Get ready to listen with your big, curious ears!

Meet President Milei from Far Away!

Imagine a country, just like our beautiful African nations, but on another continent! That's Argentina. And in Argentina, there's a leader, a very important person, called President Javier Milei. Just like your teachers or parents help decide things for your class or family, a President helps lead a whole country! They make big decisions to help everyone in their country live a good life. It's a huge job! Did you know? Argentina is famous for its delicious meat, beautiful dances called Tango, and incredible football players! Maybe one day you'll visit!

What is Money?

Before we talk about special internet money, let's think about money we all know. What do you use to buy a yummy snack? Or maybe your parents use it to buy food and clothes? Yes, coins and banknotes! Money helps us get the things we need and want. It’s how we trade our work or what we have for other things. For a long, long time, people have used different kinds of money. Sometimes, it was shiny shells, or even big heavy stones! Today, we mostly use paper notes and metal coins.

What is "Crypto"? Super Cool Digital Money!

Now, get ready for something amazing! Have you ever played a game on a tablet or computer? Sometimes, in those games, you earn special points or digital coins, right? Well, "cryptocurrency," or "crypto" for short, is a bit like that! It's a type of money that lives only on computers and the internet. You can't touch it like a coin, but it's real! People use special computer codes to make sure this internet money is safe and can be used to buy things. It’s like magic money that only computers understand! Did you know? The most famous type of cryptocurrency is called Bitcoin! It was the first one, like the first bicycle ever made!

Starting Something New: The "Launch"!

Imagine you have a super cool new toy you want to show all your friends. When you show it for the very first time, that's like a "launch"! Or maybe a new airplane takes off for its very first flight – that’s also a launch! In our story, President Milei was part of starting a brand new type of this "internet money" – a new crypto. This is called a "launch" because it was the first time this special digital coin was being introduced to people. It was a big, exciting new step!

Why Were People Worried? What's a "Trick"?

Sometimes, when new and exciting things start, some people get worried. They want to make sure everything is fair and honest. Imagine if someone tried to trick you into trading your best toy for something broken – that's not fair, right? We call that "fraud" or a "trick." Some people thought that maybe, just maybe, there was a trick involved with this new internet money and President Milei’s part in starting it. So, a special group of people started to look very, very closely at what happened. This is called an "investigation." They wanted to find out if everything was honest and fair. Did you know? Being honest means always telling the truth, even when it's hard. It's a very important quality!

Who Helps Decide What's Fair? The "Judge"!

When there are worries or questions about fairness, who helps decide what's right and what's wrong? In many countries, we have very wise and important people called "judges"! A judge is like a super smart referee who knows all the rules. They listen very carefully to everyone, look at all the clues, and then make a decision based on what is fair and true. They work in a special place called a courtroom. Their job is to make sure justice is done for everyone.

Good News! No Tricks Found!

So, what happened in Argentina with President Milei and the new internet money? The very important judge listened, looked at everything, and thought long and hard. And guess what? The judge said that President Milei did nothing wrong! Hurray! The judge said that even though the President helped start this new digital money, it was not a trick, and no one was trying to be unfair or dishonest. This is great news because it means everything was done properly and everyone can trust what happened. The investigation is now finished because the judge found no problems!

What Does This Mean for Everyone?

This good news means that people can feel more confident about this new internet money. It shows that even important leaders, like Presidents, are looked at carefully to make sure they are always doing the right thing. It's like when your parents or teachers make sure everyone in the family or class is playing fairly. It reminds us that being honest and trustworthy is super important, especially when you are a leader! It also means that the President can keep working on other important things for Argentina, knowing this worry is now behind him. Did you know? Trust is like a special bridge between people. When it's strong, people can work together happily!

Learning About Fair Play!

So, young news reporters, what can we learn from this story? We learn that sometimes new things, like internet money, can seem a little confusing or even scary at first. But it’s good to have people like judges who make sure everything is fair and clear. We also learn that honesty is the best policy! Whether it’s playing with your friends, sharing toys, or leading a whole country, being honest makes everything better and helps everyone trust each other. This story from Argentina shows us that even big leaders face questions, and it’s wonderful when those questions are answered fairly and honestly.

Your Awesome News Buddy, Signing Off!

That’s all the exciting news for today, my fantastic friends! I hope you learned something new about Presidents, money, judges, and most importantly, about honesty and fairness. Keep being curious, keep learning, and remember to always be kind and fair in everything you do! This is Jambo, your kid-friendly news reporter, signing off from our news desk here in Africa. See you next time for more amazing stories! Bye-bye!
summary: A judge in Argentina has said that President Javier Milei did nothing wrong when he helped start a new kind of internet money called crypto, meaning there were no tricks involved.
whyMatters: This is important because it means people can trust their President and feel safe about new types of money, knowing that fairness is always checked by important people like judges.

originalTitle: Seven shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, officials say
title: A Sad Story From Far Away, But Lots of Helpers Too!
content:
Hello, Amazing News Explorers!

Hello, my wonderful friends! I am your Kid-Friendly News Reporter for Africa. Today, we have some news from a place very, very far away from us. It’s a country called Jordan. Imagine a big map of the world. If you find Africa, then you look across the sea a little, you’ll find Jordan. It's a special place with its own beautiful people and stories. Sometimes, the news tells us about happy things, like new baby animals or big discoveries. But sometimes, the news tells us about sad things. It’s okay to feel sad when we hear sad news. It’s part of being human.

What Happened Far Away?

In Jordan, a very sad thing happened. Some people were at a church. A church is a special building where people go to pray, sing songs, and learn about God. It’s a place of peace and coming together. They were there for something called a funeral. A funeral is a special time when families and friends gather to say goodbye to someone they loved who has passed away. It’s a way to remember that person and share their sadness together. Sadly, while they were having this special gathering, some bad people came and caused trouble. This made many people very scared and hurt. It was a very sad and difficult time for everyone there.

A Place for Everyone: About Churches

Did you know that many people around the world go to a church? Or a mosque, or a temple? These are all special places where people go to feel close to their beliefs and their community. They are usually places where everyone feels safe and welcome. Imagine a big, beautiful building with lots of light. People go there to share stories, help each other, and think about good things. That’s what a church often is, a place for quiet reflection and joyful gathering. It makes what happened even sadder because it was in a place meant for peace.

When We Say Goodbye: About Funerals

A funeral is a very important ceremony. When someone we love passes away, it means their life on Earth has ended. It’s a time to remember all the happy moments we shared with them. Families come together to comfort each other and share stories about the person they miss. It’s a natural part of life to say goodbye. And doing it together with friends and family helps everyone feel a little bit better, even though their hearts are sad. It was during one of these sensitive times that the sad event happened.

People Who Help Us

In this sad event, some people got very hurt. We call this being “injured.” When you get a scrape on your knee or fall down and bump your head, that’s being injured. But sometimes, people get hurt more seriously and need a lot of help. Sadly, some people passed away during this sad event. This means they are no longer with us. It is a very sad thing when someone passes away, and our hearts feel soft and sad when we hear news like this. We think of their families who are missing them. Luckily, there are always good people who help. Think about doctors and nurses! They are superheroes without capes. They rush to help anyone who is hurt, making sure they get the best care to feel better. Many doctors and nurses quickly came to help everyone who was injured. They are very brave and kind. Did you know that doctors and nurses work all over the world? They help people in hospitals and clinics, always trying their best to make sick or hurt people healthy again. They were there in Jordan, caring for everyone.

What Does "Injured" Mean?

When we say 34 people were injured, it means many people got hurt. They needed to go to the hospital so doctors could look after them. Some might have needed bandages, some might have needed medicine, and some just needed a warm, kind voice to tell them everything would be okay. It's like when you fall off your bike. Sometimes it's a little scrape, sometimes it's a bigger bump. These people had bigger bumps and needed lots of care. We send them all our wishes to get well very, very soon.

Working Together for Safety

The people who caused this trouble are not good. And what happens when bad people do bad things? Brave police officers step in to help! The police in Jordan are working very hard right now. They are looking for the bad people who did this sad thing. Did you know that police officers are in almost every country in the world? Their job is to keep everyone safe and make sure people follow the rules. They want everyone to live in peace and harmony. They are working day and night to find the people responsible so that justice can be served.

Did You Know? Fun Facts About Our World!

* Did you know that Jordan is a country in Asia? It has ancient cities and beautiful deserts! It's very different from many parts of Africa, but all people are part of our one big human family. * Did you know that helping others makes us feel good? When we see someone sad or hurt, offering a kind word or a helping hand can make a big difference. * Did you know that there are so many different cultures and ways people pray and celebrate across the globe? It's amazing to learn about them!

What Can We Learn?

This news reminds us that even though there are sad things, there are also so many good people in the world. People who help, people who care, and people who work for peace. It also reminds us how important it is to be kind to each other. Every day, we can choose to be a helper, a friend, and someone who spreads joy. We can play nicely, share our toys, and listen to our teachers. These small acts of kindness make our world a better, safer place for everyone.

Being Kind and Safe

Even though this happened far away, it’s good to remember that our own communities and schools are safe places. We have our parents, teachers, and local helpers who always look out for us. Let’s keep thinking about the people in Jordan, sending them warm thoughts of healing and peace. And let’s all promise to be kind, gentle, and helpful every single day. Because when we are kind, we make the world a brighter, happier place for all! Thank you for listening, my little news explorers!
summary: In the country of Jordan, far away, a sad thing happened at a church funeral where bad people caused trouble, hurting many and causing some to pass away, but good doctors and police are helping everyone.
whyMatters: This sad news reminds us that even when bad things happen, many brave people help, and it’s important for all of us to be kind and care for each other to make the world safe and peaceful.
